date: "2026-06-03"

#Environment 

```{r}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(visreg)
library(tidyverse)
library(effectsize)
library(wesanderson)
library(patchwork)
library(car)
library(effectsize)

data <- read_csv("bw_distract_correlational_data.csv")

#palette
zissou_full <- wes_palette("Zissou1", n = 5, type = "discrete")
col_palette <- zissou_full[c(2, 3)]

```

#check outliers 

```{r}

#detect 
check_outliers(
  data$ibq_reg,
  method = "zscore",
  threshold = 3
) #none

check_outliers(
  data$cbq_effcon,
  method = "zscore",
  threshold = 3
) #none

check_outliers(
  data$bewith_anger_all_36,
  method = "zscore",
  threshold = 3
) #one (case 17)

check_outliers(
  data$distract_anger_all_36,
  method = "zscore",
  threshold = 3
) #none


#winsorize one value for bewith_anger
x <- data$bewith_anger_all_36

m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

lower <- m - 3*s
upper <- m + 3*s

#winsorize outliers 
data$bewith_anger_all_36_win <- ifelse(
  is.na(x), NA,
  ifelse(x < lower, lower,
         ifelse(x > upper, upper, x))
)

#check N and descriptives
sum(x < lower | x > upper, na.rm = TRUE) #

summary(data$bewith_anger_all_36)
summary(data$bewith_anger_all_36_win) #confirmed only one value changed (case 17) 

```

#associations between being-with/distract in response to justified and unjustified anger at 36 months with CBCL self-regulation at 36 months, controlling for IBQ self-regulation at 6 months 

```{r}

reg_36m <- lm(cbq_effcon ~ bewith_anger_all_36_win + distract_anger_all_36 + ibq_reg, data = data)
summary(reg_36m)
confint(reg_36m, level = 0.95)
standardize_parameters(reg_36m)

#change cov to 18mo EC
reg_36m_18cv <- lm(cbq_effcon ~ bewith_anger_all_36_win + distract_anger_all_36 + ecbq_reg, data = data)
summary(reg_36m_18cv)
standardize_parameters(reg_36m_18cv)

#change outcome to NA
neg_36m <- lm(cbq_negaff ~ bewith_anger_all_36_win + distract_anger_all_36 + ibq_neg, data = data)
summary(neg_36m)
standardize_parameters(neg_36m)


```

#plot main findings

```{r}

#being-with
vis_be <- visreg(
  reg_36m,
  "bewith_anger_all_36_win",
  gg = FALSE,
  partial = TRUE
)

#extract fitted line + CI
fit_be <- vis_be$fit

#extract partial residuals
res_be <- vis_be$res

bw <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = res_be,
    aes(x = bewith_anger_all_36_win, y = visregRes),
    shape = 21, color = "black", fill = NA, size = 2, stroke = 0.80) +
  geom_ribbon(data = fit_be,
    aes(x = bewith_anger_all_36_win, ymin = visregLwr, ymax = visregUpr),
    fill = "#AA3377", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = fit_be,
    aes(x = bewith_anger_all_36_win, y = visregFit),
    color = "#AA3377", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Being-with",
    y = "Child effortful control") +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(2.70, 6),
    ylim = c(3.25, 6)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(3, 6, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(3, 6, by = 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))


#distract
vis_dist <- visreg(
  reg_36m,
  "distract_anger_all_36",
  gg = FALSE,
  partial = TRUE
)

#extract fitted line + CI
fit_dist <- vis_dist$fit

#extract partial residuals
res_dist <- vis_dist$res

dis <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = res_dist,
    aes(x = distract_anger_all_36, y = visregRes),
    shape = 21, color = "black", fill = NA, size = 2, stroke = 0.80) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = fit_dist,
    aes(x = distract_anger_all_36, ymin = visregLwr, ymax = visregUpr),
    fill = "#44AA99", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(
    data = fit_dist,
    aes(x = distract_anger_all_36, y = visregFit),
    color = "#44AA99", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Distraction",
    y = NULL) + 
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(2.70, 6),
    ylim = c(3.25, 6)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(3, 6, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(3, 6, by = 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

#add statistics
bw <- bw + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = "\u03B2 = 0.22, 95% CI [0.02, 0.41]",
    hjust = 1.05, vjust = -1, size = 4)

dis <- dis + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = "\u03B2 = 0.07, 95% CI [-0.13, 0.26]",
    hjust = 1.05, vjust = -1, size = 4)

#combine
combined_plot <- bw + dis
combined_plot <- combined_plot + 
  plot_annotation(caption = "Self-reported strategy use in response to anger") &
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ))

ggsave("bw_dis_cbq_imp.png", combined_plot, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```
